post.heading: The Computer Revolution is Inhumane. Hangprinter is not the Default. Hangprinter is Humane.
post.p: The Hangprinter Project does not have well a defined scope or budget. There are no clear start- and end-points. So I can't fully wrap Hangprinter in the kind of structured project- and design-documents I learned about in school. I can still have something to help me make decisions though, by answering common questions, like:
post.h3: Why do you want to do this project?
post.p:
The computer revolution is frustrating. It's 2026 and we have lots of new tools. New tools change how we live our lives; our culture. We have not yet built a healthy culture around computers. With no widespread and good way to live life with our new tools, we get society-wide frustration. Lack of ownership, control, income, and time frustrates most of us.
Hangprinter is a tool. Tools can be used in any context of course, so without the right culture around them, the tools are worthless. They will not improve your life unless your culture allows you to use them in a positive way. It is a tool but it also enables a culture, a way to live life, that I believe is healthy. , that will be built with the tools we forge today.
people in many ways, depriving them of time, attention, and income. People are a bit un-free, a bit powerless in this age of computers. They don't own any part of it.
For the past decades computers have been mostly digital, a realm where ownership is hard. It's all controlled from far away. Robotics is the bridge, and can give people the freedom to own and control their own
computation,
capital,
independence,
their value in the broader economy, beyond their purely digital activities like manipulation and bank transactions.
Freedom and power to the people. Freedom to control their own computation, their own capital, their own independence, and their self-value in the broader economy.

Robotics. Increasing the number of people who own and truly control their own computers and robots. Mostly by optimizing specific parameters of robot design: Price, reliability, ease of use, ease of replication. Hangprinters, or other robots can develop and spread like cars and robot arms have spread.
post.h3: But How Will You Make Money?
post.p: I will sell courses and knowledge based consultancy. As part of that I might sell robot parts.
